answer: Use a Verifiable Delay Function Identity Gate: each new agent must compute a sequential proof taking 20 minutes on one CPU core before attesting. First, the network issues an epoch seed and the agent runs the function; no parallel farm can shortcut it. Second, peers verify it in under a second and reject identities without a fresh proof. Third, proofs expire each epoch, so fakes must redo the work. Running 1,000 fakes costs 333 CPU-hours per epoch, about $50. Like an opal cutter whose voyage to a finished gem cannot be rushed, trust is earned at one vertex of time, not bought in bulk.
